subject.title: Dashboard: workspace time-travel — history scrub, version diff, and widget→logbook blame

question: Should OpenClaw accept dashboard workspace time-travel as a bundled dashboard roadmap item now, and should implementation wait for the Wave 1 dashboard storage, provenance, and security contract to settle?
rationale: The request is a new user-facing auditability surface layered on an unsettled default dashboard/plugin stack, so automation cannot choose the product boundary or storage/security exceptions for maintainers.

options.title: Keep Open Behind Dashboard Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical time-travel child and require the Wave 1 dashboard backend/storage/provenance decisions to settle before implementation starts.

options.title: Move To External Experiment
options.body: Ask for this auditability layer to remain an external plugin or ClawHub experiment until maintainers choose to promote the dashboard stack.

options.title: Defer The Roadmap Item
options.body: Leave the roadmap tracker intact but explicitly deprioritize or close this child if dashboard time-travel is not current product scope.

recommendation.title: Keep Open Behind Dashboard Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical time-travel child and require the Wave 1 dashboard backend/storage/provenance decisions to settle before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the merged plugin-tab/Logbook precedent and is the strongest history-backed routing owner for bundled Control UI product direction.
